svg.title: A chick hops down a scene's source and builds its picture
svg.desc: A few lines of svjeez source fill in one at a time. A chick hops down them word by word, and each word it lands on pops into the picture beside it as what it names: a sun, or a moon at night, hills, a kite and a cloud. The chick jumps onto the hill, holds the kite string, and everything clears for the next round.
